title: Forensics by Symbol Table
prompt: Implement `char classify_symbol(const char *line)` parsing one `nm` output line like '0000000000401100 T bump' — return the type letter. Then implement `int is_defined(char t)` returning 1 for T/t/D/d/B/b/R/r and 0 for U/u/w/v.

tests.name: parses the letter
tests.hint: A single-letter first field means the symbol is undefined (no address column); otherwise the letter follows the address.

tests.name: defined vs not
tests.hint: Lowercase defined letters (t/d/b/r) are file-local but still defined; U/u/w/v are resolution debts.
